purpose: Federation navigation, cross-repository source pins, conformance checks, reproducibility snapshots, and agent routing. This repository does not decide mathematical status or duplicate canonical repository-role metadata.

repository_registry.meaning: sole machine source for existing repository roles plus artifact routing and byte identities; not claim status

scientific_authority_map.meaning: historical source on a non-default branch; absent at the observed Main tip; not evidence of current authority

downstream_gate.meaning: existing downstream classification/control surface; workspace does not duplicate it

landing_claims.meaning: public landing projection; not a promotion engine
